title: 3-Milk Cloud Tres Leches Cake
hookLine: Featherlight sponge soaked in three milks and crowned with vanilla bean chantilly cream.

steps.title: Preheat Oven & Prep Your Pan
steps.instructionTemplate: Preheat your oven to 350°F (175°C) and line your baking pan with parchment paper, leaving a slight overhang for effortless lifting. Measure out {eggs_tl}, {flour_tl}, and {sugar_tl} so everything is ready and at room temperature for a silky, lump-free batter.

steps.title: Whip Airy Sponge & Bake 25m
steps.instructionTemplate: Beat egg yolks + half of {sugar_tl}, fold in whipped egg whites and {flour_tl}. Bake at 350°F (175°C) for 25 minutes. Line your baking pan with parchment paper or grease lightly, and make sure {eggs_tl}, {flour_tl}, and {sugar_tl} are measured and at room temperature so they blend smoothly.

steps.title: Pour 3-Milk Blend Over Cake
steps.instructionTemplate: Poke holes all over cooled sponge with a fork and slowly pour {milks_tl} until fully absorbed. Chill 2 hours. Mix gently until just combined with no dry streaks remaining, then bake until the edges are golden and a toothpick comes out with moist crumbs.

steps.title: Frost with Chantilly & Cinnamon
steps.instructionTemplate: Spread fluffy {whip_tl} across the top and dust lightly with cinnamon. Let 3-Milk Cloud Tres Leches Cake cool for 10–15 minutes so the crumb sets cleanly before slicing into 9 portions, then garnish and serve.
steps.creatorSecret: Using separated whipped egg whites makes the sponge drink up all three milks without collapsing.

ugcQuotes.quote: Turned out bakery-grade on my first try! Ready in 40 mins.
